date_scope_check.qualification_retained: REC50-R13-003-P1: The full Mosaïque report was recovered and confirms a 14:00–22:00 interruption on August 10, 2023, with Tunisians returning to Tunisia and Libyans returning to Libya allowed to pass. Le Temps independently relays a TAP crossing-official account of restored traffic late Thursday and normal operation Friday morning. The reason remains unstated, and the reports do not enumerate all freight or third-country categories. The eight-hour difference is based on reported clocks, not gate logs; no whole-day duration is inferred. Phase geography remains unlocated in the existing phase table.
